reviewer: generation-9 worker — exact artifact verification plus chrome-devtools-mcp route/device/theme matrix

rubric.evidence: models/interactive-segmenter/acceptance-run.json contains 10/10 populated route/device records. MagicTouch produced distinct foreground coverage (portrait 23.6%, dog 14.1%, sneaker 17.6%, bicycle 1.3%, cat 45.3%) at 100% prompted-point confidence in Chrome 150.
rubric.notes: models/interactive-segmenter/worker.js calls InteractiveSegmenter.segment() on a transferred ImageBitmap; no canned output path exists.

rubric.evidence: Each acceptance record exposes an image-resolution foreground confidence plus category mask, selected-pixel count, coverage, point/mean confidence and bounds. The overview record is 722×1000 with 23.6% coverage; multi-model is 1600×1200 with 45.3% coverage.
rubric.notes: The model card's raw contract is 512×512×4 input and 512×512×2 background/foreground logits; MediaPipe maps the task masks back to image resolution.

rubric.evidence: artifact.json pins tasks-vision 0.10.18 and MagicTouch float32 generation 1683146867404767 (6,227,884 bytes, SHA-256 e24338a…cd25). evidence/mcp-exact-runtime.txt retains HTTP 200 requests for that numbered artifact, the exact CDN package and WASM files.
rubric.notes: The worker verifies SHA-256 before createFromOptions and reports CPU fallback after a real adapter probe in the accepted runtime.

rubric.evidence: acceptance-run.json lifecycle: first-visit download-required → ready; release → released; load into memory → ready from the verified Cache Storage copy; clear cache removed one file and returned download-required.
rubric.notes: The immutable generation is passed as model.revision so no mutable update check can silently replace it.

rubric.evidence: MCP lifecycle proves offline cached inference (23.6% coverage), visible offline fetch failure ('Failed to fetch'), Retry recovery to ready, release, reload and clear-cache. All errors use the visible status region.
rubric.notes: The custom verified fetch emits real byte progress through the shared download component.

rubric.evidence: MCP exercised visible sample selection, native Segment control and every route on desktop/mobile. Earlier retained route-matrix passes also exercised Overlay/Confidence/Cut-out/Spotlight, both sliders, spatial presets and the practical export before the compact attestation run.
rubric.notes: Canvas has keyboard target movement plus Enter/Space; nine native preset buttons provide a non-pointer alternative.

rubric.evidence: Coverage varies by sample and route; mask bounds, timings and confidence are computed from the worker's real confidence array. Multi-model returns five untouched MobileViT ImageNet labels for the actual cut-out.
rubric.notes: evidence/screenshots/multi-desktop-dark.webp visibly shows the real cat cut-out and five scored labels.

rubric.evidence: Acceptance records report zero unnamed buttons and zero missing alt attributes; the canvas has an accessible name/description, native inputs/buttons, visible focus, polite status, semantic diagnostics table and textual equivalents for visual masks.
rubric.notes: No screen-reader hardware session was run; browser accessibility snapshots were used.

rubric.evidence: 10/10 route/device records at 1280×800 and 360×740 DPR3 report zero horizontal overflow. Twenty retained light/dark screenshots cover every route on both device classes; multi-mobile's pinned revision overflow was found and fixed with anywhere wrapping.
rubric.notes: Coarse-pointer targets use 2.75rem minimum block size; controls wrap within a container query.

rubric.evidence: Inference, confidence reduction and dense RGBA composition run in the classic MediaPipe worker; input ImageBitmap and output RGBA buffer are transferred. Observed multi-model CPU timings were 208.9 ms MagicTouch / 18.8 ms compose and 183.7 ms MobileViT with responsive controls.
rubric.notes: Classic rather than module worker is the documented MediaPipe FilesetResolver exception; deterministic terminate closes both tasks.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible point selection on canvas with keyboard controls and textual coordinates
guidanceConsulted.applied: Used native buttons/inputs, canvas name and description, arrow+Enter keyboard operation, nine point presets, centralized polite status and a semantic tensor table instead of relying on pixels alone. HTML-in-Canvas was not used because it is unsupported; real DOM remains beside the canvas.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive image canvas controls mobile touch targets no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.applied: Used logical sizing, container queries, wrapping toolbars, 2.75rem coarse-pointer targets, visible focus, touch-action:pan-y, max-inline-size containment and anywhere wrapping for exact hashes/revisions.

guidanceConsulted.query: large model download progress retry accessible status browser cache
guidanceConsulted.applied: Kept heavy work off-thread, used the shared progress/status component, required explicit first download, verified one Cache Storage copy, and exposed retry/release/clear states.

openQuestions: GPU delegate inference was not available in the exact Chrome 150 runner; CPU/WASM is verified and the GPU attempt falls back visibly.
MediaPipe emits two benign warnings in this headless CPU runtime (OpenGL checking disabled and feedback tensors disabled); there are zero console errors.

followUpGoals.goal: Run the same pinned artifact on a physical WebGPU-capable desktop and mobile device to retain GPU-delegate timings.
Add a negative/background point refinement model as a distinct future demo rather than changing this one-keypoint MagicTouch contract.
